note: BoxData BoxTypes 0/1/2 map to common/stage boss/act boss slots. Plague (Contaminated) chests are stored separately (v1.02.00) and use MaxAmountPlague*Chest rune chains with boxTypes 3/4/5. Rune keys from game RuneInfoData (MaxAmount*Chest). The v1.3.0 Halloween event chests (940xxx/941xxx) get TWO slots of their own (boxTypes 6/7, companion-internal ids - the game has no event BoxType): eventNormal (940xxx, common tier) and eventStage (941xxx, stage-boss tier), mirroring the normal / stage-boss split of the regular chests. The game ships no MaxAmountEvent*Chest chain, so both event slots reuse the corresponding base chain's numbers (base 5, +1/level, same rune nodes as common / stage boss). Note: the event boxes have NO auto-open and NO drop cooldown in the game (no UnlockAutoOpenEvent*Chest node; ItemInfoData.DropCooldown = 3 s), so the event slots are holding counters only - see docs/business-flows/09-chest-and-autoclassify.md 13.7.
